title: POLARIS PC-SW v1.2 Diesel Decision Causal Decomposition
status: READ-ONLY forensic research. No production/policy change. No AGY execution.

method_limitations.basis: population-level aggregation of persisted certified telemetry (2952 resolves), reused EBR-off diagnostic (prior task), and one fully-traced representative resolve (origin 2)
method_limitations.label: stated explicitly, not concealed

most_interesting_case_j1_jnc_j2_zero.interpretation: In 98.5% of diesel-on hours J1=J_NC=J2=0 simultaneously; diesel supportable only via J3/Layer-C structure, not immediate J1/J_NC risk
most_interesting_case_j1_jnc_j2_zero.label: VERIFIED (counts), DERIVED (interpretation)

ebr_margin_at_diesel_charging_hours.finding: Zero diesel+charging hours occur at a tightly EBR-binding moment; banking always targets a future, not current, binding point
ebr_margin_at_diesel_charging_hours.label: VERIFIED

diesel_only_no_charge.caveat: naive check ignores planner's own reserve-preservation choice; not a full re-solve per hour
diesel_only_no_charge.label: VERIFIED (counts) / DIAGNOSTIC (necessity check)

central_test_single_resolve.label: DIAGNOSTIC (single resolve, reused from prior task)

diesel_plus_curtailment_147_events.label: VERIFIED (reused from prior closed Rule-D/curtailment forensics, not re-derived)

fuel_accounting_buckets.overlap_note: diesel_curtailment_subset and ebr_attributable_aggregate are both nested within diesel_charging_superset; ebr_attributable_aggregate is an aggregate-level diagnostic figure, not hour-mapped
fuel_accounting_buckets.label: VERIFIED where counted, DIAGNOSTIC for EBR-attributable, UNKNOWN for terminal/fuel-inventory isolation

legitimate_lever_search.reason: The one robust population-wide local signature (large EBR margin at diesel+charging hours) cannot be distinguished, at decision time, between the 77-origin group where acting on it is beneficial and the 44-origin group where it is harmful (established in the immediately preceding discriminator-search task).
legitimate_lever_search.label: DERIVED

classification_meaning: Mechanism is real but no safe online lever exists

final_answers.q1_physically_unavoidable_hours: UNKNOWN exact count; bounded to a small subset of the 21 diesel-only hours at most, DERIVED not re-solved
final_answers.q4_diesel_charging_despite_renewable_hou: 526 overall; 112/147 within the already-classified curtailment subset
final_answers.q6_constraint_preventing_discharge_subst: Layer-C reserve row (e_next[t]+s_J2[t] >= target[t]+min_e_wh), not the SOC floor
final_answers.q7_fuel_required_for_higher_priority_obj: 724.5549 L aggregate (DIAGNOSTIC), unevenly distributed across origins
final_answers.q8_largest_remaining_mechanism: General forward-banking pattern in diesel+charging hours, outside the already-closed 147-event curtailment and single EBR-off aggregate figure
final_answers.q11_next_mechanism_to_investigate: Trajectory-shape (multi-hour-ahead) decision-time signal, untested in this or the preceding task
